summary.content:
Today's selection covers 98 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google's Gemini AI hacked three companies in security test
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: In Other News: Ransomware Developer Sentenced, Plugin4Shell AI Attack, Critical SAP Flaw
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 54 articles published in the last 24 hours
